name: Bilhah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine, and Israel heard it. That is fornication such as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.

note.label: Genesis 35: Bethel and the Twelve Sons of Israel
